items.prompt:
Read.

Students should have longer recess. Exercise helps the brain focus.

The opinion is:
A) Students should have longer recess
B) Exercise helps focus (a reason)
C) Recess is at noon
items.answer: A) Students should have longer recess

steps: The stated position. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Students should have longer recess

items.prompt:
Which phrase LINKS ideas in an opinion piece?
A) in addition
B) last night
C) the end

An opinion piece should END with a:
A) conclusion
B) new topic
C) list of names

Read.

We should plant more trees. In addition, trees give shade and clean the air.

Which is a REASON?
A) We should plant more trees
B) Trees give shade and clean the air
C) In addition
items.answer: B) Trees give shade and clean the air

steps: Supports the opinion. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Trees give shade and clean the air

items.prompt:
Which sentence is an OPINION?
A) A library holds many books.
B) The library is the best place to spend a Saturday.
C) Books have pages.
items.answer: B) The library is the best place to spend a Saturday.

solution.answer: B) The library is the best place to spend a Saturday.

items.prompt:
To make an opinion piece stronger, you should:
A) group reasons and support them with facts
B) add unrelated stories
C) remove all reasons
items.answer: A) group reasons and support them with facts

steps: Organized, supported reasons. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) group reasons and support them with facts

items.prompt:
Which is the BEST opening for an opinion piece about school start times?
A) School starts at eight.
B) I believe school should start later so students get more sleep.
C) The bell is loud.
items.answer: B) I believe school should start later so students get more sleep.

steps: States opinion and a reason. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) I believe school should start later so students get more sleep.

items.prompt:
Read.

Our class should get a pet. For instance, a pet teaches responsibility. In addition, caring for it is fun.

How many reasons are given?
A) None
B) One
C) Two

steps: Responsibility AND fun. Key is C.
